The '''mission''' to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] world of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] was part of the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s hunt for its former member [[Theron Shan]], who unknown to the Alliance leadership went deep undercover and joined the [[Order of Zildrog]]. The Order tasked him with recovering coordinates to [[Zildrog]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]], and Shan infiltrated Copero's [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] under guise of seeking refuge from the Alliance. Learning of this, [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] declared ruling [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] rogue and asked the [[Alliance Commander]] to apprehend them both, promising that the Ascendancy would look the other way. Saganu brough the Commander and Ascendancy representative [[Raina Temple]] to Copero, where they apprehended Zenta and learned from her about Shan's true motives. They rushed to stop him, but Shan and Zenta's brother [[Valss]] have already accessed and activated the holomap, destroying it after they obtained the information they were after. Valss stayed behind and was killed, but Shan was able to escape and report his finding back to the Order, while the Commander returned to [[Odessen]] along with Temple, who offered to continue working the Alliance.

==History==
===Prelude===
When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] revealed itself to the larger galaxy in [[3681 BBY]]<ref>{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}} indicates that the war begins twenty-eight years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' date to [[3653 BBY]].</ref> and began to wage [[Great Galactic War]] again the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] became the only actual ally of the Empire, unlike all other species that the Empire had subjugated. The exact details of the [[Chiss–Imperial treaty|agreement]] remained a mystery to all but the highest-ranking officials,<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|Chiss Ascendancy}}</ref> but to secure the Ascendancy interests the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] send a team to steal a collateral from [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] in case the deal fell through. They obtained a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] that kept one of Vitiate's greatest secrets<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" /> - coordinates to [[Zildrog]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of destroying entire civilizations<ref name="Nathema" /> - which was brought for safekeeping to the Ascendancy world of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] where only the highest-ranking [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] could access it.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />

[[File:Aristocra_Saganu_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Aristocra Saganu asks the Eternal Alliance for assistance.]]
More than half a century later, in [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date Iokath">{{TOR_updates|5.2}}</ref> a group known as the [[Order of Zildrog]] began the search for Zildrog's location, intending to use it against the [[Eternal Alliance]]. Alliance member [[Theron Shan]] learned about it and faked defection to the Order, intending to bring it down from within.<ref name="Nathema" /> After proving his dedication on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], Shan was tasked with obtaining the holomap from Copero's ruling [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] and convinced ruling [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] to provide him refuge in exchange for the Alliance secrets. This was seen as an act of treason by the head of Chiss Expansionary Defense Force [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]], who was unable to act against Zenta for political reasons. Instead, Saganu traveled to the Alliance capital of [[Odessen]] and revealed Shan's whereabout to [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], asking them to apprehend both traitors without the Ascendancy's official involvement. Though outsiders have never been allowed on Copero before, Saganu offered to bring the Commander there so they could apprehend both Shan and Zenta, asking only that [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Raina Temple]] accompany them to ensure Ascendancy's interests.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />

===The mission===
[[File:Theron_Shan_and_Valss.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Theron Shan and Valss discover the holomap.]]
On Copero, Zenta's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] brother [[Valss]] experienced a vision of Shan's victory, which led him and several of Zenta's best fighters to join the Order's cause. Shan sliced into Zenta's personal [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to reveal the map's location in the [[Ancient ruins (Copero)|ancient ruins]] and headed there along with Valss and others, abandoning the Syndic. Meanwhile, Saganu's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] delivered Temple and the Commander to [[Copero City]] landing platform, from which they proceeded to cut their way through House Inrokini security personnel. Along the way they were asked to destroy supplies stolen from the Ascendancy and to plant [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] on House Inrokini communication relays. Believing the situation to be under her control, Zenta ordered citizens of Copero to stay away from the fighting, even as Temple and the Commander fought their way into the nearby [[Inrokini Stronghold|shipyard]]. Inside they sliced House Inrokini security terminals, revealing that Zenta had been gathering both Alliance and Ascendancy secrets for a while, and eventually engaged the Syndic herself.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />

[[File:Raina_Temple_and_Syndic_Zenta.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Raina Temple and Commander subdue Syndic Zenta.]]
Zenta was disarmed by Temple, who took away her [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] and opened a holochannel to Saganu. Defeated, the Syndic explained that she had been duped by the Shan just like the others were and revealed that Shan had joined a group searching a powerful superweapon. She provided Temple and the Commander with the map's coordinates so they could stop him, but Saganu insisted on settling her matter first, offering the Commander a promise of political alliance if they killed the Syndic on the spot. Meanwhile, Shan and Valss successfully accessed the map,<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" /> and Theron learned that Zildrog was located on [[Nathema]],<ref name="Nathema" /> after which they blew it with explosives to prevent anyone from following their trail.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The Commander refused to carry out Saganu's dirty work, much to the Aristocta's disappointment, and instead rushed to apprehend Shan along with Temple. Exiting the shipyard through an exit on a mountain slope, the Commander had to tame a [[pantran whitefang]] beast, whom the Chiss used to guard their secrets. They then had to contend with a test of logic, using a steam distributor to melt a wall of ice that blocked their way. After disabling security laser grid in the maze outside the temple, the Commander and Temple rushed in just as Shan's group was preparing to depart on a [[Zakuul]]an shuttle. Valss ordered the rest to go and despite Shan's protests engaged them in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], giving Shan a chance to escape. The Commander and Temple fought Valss and eventually killed him, after which they were forced to return to Odessen empty-handed.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" />
{{EndGame}}

===Aftermath===
Back on Odessen, Temple informed the Commander on the political fallout resulting from the exposure of Aristocra's actions and volunteered to join the [[Eternal Alliance]], believing her connections to the Ascendancy to be of value to it. [[Lana Beniko]]'s team have recovered the remains of the holomap from Copero and Beniko put their best [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] into reassembling it. Meanwhile Shan transmitted Zildrog's the coordinates to the Order's leader [[Vinn Atrius]], while intentionally leaving the channel open so that the Alliance could intercept their talk and learn of the Order's existence.<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss" /> The Order soon found Zildrog on Nathema and prepared to awaken it, and Shan, still maintaining his cover, send another encrypted message to the Alliance so that they could learn about the Order's plans and stop Zildrog's threat.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
During the "A Traitor Among the Chiss" flashpoint players have three options to deal with Syndic Zenta. The [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side]] options are to either send her back to House Inrokini or take her prisoner for crimes against the Alliance, in both cases leading to a political turmoil and possible war among the Chiss. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] options is to kill Zenta on the spot, in which case Saganu will privately offer the Alliance his support, while officially the Ascendancy will blame the Alliance for the Syndic's death.
